label: Send Email
description: Send an email as the connected mailbox, over SMTP (the standard sending protocol every mail provider serves). Set replyToMessageId to answer inside an existing conversation.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The mailbox's access (wire an EmailAccess node). Needs the connection's outgoing (SMTP) server, which is what sending mail uses.

inputs.name: replyToMessageId
inputs.description: The Message-ID being answered (from ReceiveEmail's messageId output); sets the reply headers so mail clients thread it.
